evidence_commit_relation: This evidence file is committed after the implementation commit and intentionally references the stable code commit SHA above.

facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert; no runtime, database, or production data migration is involved.
facets.F11_observability: Hosted CI check rollup plus local evidence commands expose generated-output policy status; regenerated faces upload as workflow evidence.
facets.F13_migration: Moves generated artifacts from contributor merge surfaces toward controller/materialized cloud-ci artifacts applicable across projects and repos.
facets.F1_correctness: Tracked generated outputs are governed by manifest-backed generated_path_rules; stale SCM facts for deleted generated clients now fail a regression test instead of being masked; PR diff rejection is manifest-derived rather than .gitignore-derived.
facets.F2_tests: rustfmt, bash -n, node --check, jq, workflow YAML parse, focused generated-artifact Buck2 gate, generated-output policy binary positive/negative smokes, full buck2 test //cloud/cloud-ci/... (25 pass), app-shell codegen/typecheck, diff-check, and hosted bridge-failure root-cause reproduction passed locally.
facets.F3_maintainability: Generated artifact lifecycle is encoded in one manifest/schema/Rust gate path; app-shell generated clients regenerate from canonical OpenAPI contracts instead of being committed.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing cloud-ci generated JSON consumers still receive materialized files in CI; deleted app-shell generated clients are replaced by deterministic codegen checks.
facets.F5_security: No secrets or privileged credentials are added; checkout persists no credentials; Buck2 bridge install is digest-pinned on Linux x86_64.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant, user, or personal-data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: Single required oya-ci-required fan-in includes generated-output-diff-policy, app-shell codegen, Buck2, registry-drift, firewall, and gate lanes; the diff policy compiles from the same Rust cloud-ci gate crate, pre-provisions the pinned Rust toolchain, and leaves Buck2 stderr visible for debuggability.
facets.F8_performance: Avoids generated-output conflict churn and keeps Buck2 cloud-ci tests scoped to existing cloud-ci gates; no runtime path is introduced.
facets.F9_compliance: Preserves intentional deletion posture, no new Markdown, and records multispectrum/audit evidence with PR template traceability.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected the false-green filesystem projection; the gate must validate the supplied SCM facts snapshot and CI must supply candidate-tree facts.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: The pipeline is treated as product: reusable manifest/schema policy, hermetic Rust predicates, fan-in, and generated artifact lifecycle are encoded so future repos avoid generated-output conflict surfaces by design.

hyperscaler_lens.canonical: generated-output policy is expressed as a reusable Rust cloud-ci gate plus manifest/schema; GitHub bridge policy invokes the same manifest-derived Rust predicate instead of gitignore heuristics
hyperscaler_lens.cloud_native: GitHub Actions remains a bridge runner; oya-ci/cloud-ci is the productized fan-in and generated artifact controller shape
hyperscaler_lens.hermetic: gate consumes declared manifest + candidate-tree materialized SCM facts; presubmit diff policy consumes declared manifest + name-status stream; no runner-local ignore policy is authoritative
hyperscaler_lens.public_product: manifest generated_path_rules, generated-output-diff-policy binary, and cloud-ci materialization contract are portable to other repos/projects
